source.scale_source: Embedded AVM Spatial.Scale; original dimensions match AVM reference dimensions.
source.credit: ESA/Webb, NASA & CSA, P. Zeidler, E. Sabbi, A. Nota, M. Zamani (ESA/Webb)

processing.precision: float32 FFT; float64 PSFs and checks
processing.source_transfer: ICC-managed sRGB decoded to linear-light RGB; not calibrated astronomical intensity
processing.convolution: Same unit-flux 1.65 um PSF applied to each RGB channel; full 768x768 support and native tilt, no recentring or PSF scale multiplier
processing.overview: Full source footprint; pixel-area averaged to 2x native PSF grid. Kernel flux exactly redistributed by area overlap to 385x385. Final overview reduced with Lanczos.
processing.detail: Native PSF pixel grid; 384x384 output plus full 768 pixel surrounding source context; no missing source pixels
processing.boundary: Overview extends edge values by full kernel support. Unknown external sky affects outer ~19.8 arcsec; central magnifier is independent of this edge assumption.
processing.orientation: Source image axes retained; PSF row order assigned to image rows by convention, not a fitted sky/pupil alignment
processing.field_assumption: One spatially invariant on-axis PSF across entire ~3 arcmin field: illustrative only, not predicted wide-field AO correction
processing.display: One sRGB transfer for all frames and panels, no exposure/contrast adjustment, no colour reassignment; lossless WebP frames
processing.time: All 159 existing image times; no interpolation; Strehl remains native point-source metric
